result.summary: Found 1 significant visual issue: a loading indicator remains visible over content that appears to have already loaded.

issues.description: A large loading spinner is overlaid in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image even though the restaurant image is already displayed, making the card look stuck or unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Remove the loading indicator as soon as the image finishes loading, or replace the image with a clear skeleton/placeholder until loading is complete.
